arm_meanings.original: exact original frozen TABM boundary BE plus common SAGE body
arm_meanings.factor: live boundary BE; private hidden r/s and original-bias-presence private biases; no permutations
arm_meanings.coordinate: factor arm plus fixed independently generated hidden input/output gathers
arm_meanings.permutation: boundary_BE_plus_hidden_permutations_biases; identity INTERIOR factors, boundary factors remain live
arm_meanings.bias_only: live boundary BE; identity hidden transforms and private biases where original maps were biased
arm_meanings.single: ordinary one-member SAGE; copied shared TABM maps/norms, ordinary boundaries omit private factors
arm_meanings.untied: members independent ordinary SAGE models; caller chooses compact width analytically
arm_meanings.heads: one complete ordinary SAGE trunk and members private hidden_dim->hidden_dim->classes GELU heads
arm_meanings.gt_sep_single: separate original GT-sep ordinary single reference

mean_prediction: runner applies per-member C-way softmax then averages probabilities
member_loss: runner declares equal member CE and includes all member work
initialization: same seed gives identical frozen TABM base and unit interior factors; private hidden biases copy original shared biases
permutation_rng: local CPU torch.Generator(permutation_seed), fixed indices checkpointed as int64 buffers; no rejected/redrawn routes
norm_skip_contract: common affine LayerNorm and identity residual skips are unchanged and unpermuted; this is not a coherent full-network gauge
semantic_contract: no new context on input_be_block.W or output_be_block.W; raw input and class coordinates are not permuted
dataset_fields: owned by the separate runner/study protocol; no dataset is selected by this interface
qualification_tests: test_analytic.py is drafted and MUST NOT run until root source/runtime admission
